summaries.text:
Consumer Fairness Act of 2003 - Amends the Consumer Credit Protection Act to treat as an unfair and deceptive trade act or practice under Federal or State law any written provision in a consumer transaction or contract which requires binding arbitration to resolve a controversy arising out of or related to the transaction or contract, or the failure to perform any part.
 Declares such a provision unenforceable.
 Permits a written agreement to determine an existing controversy by binding arbitration if the parties agree after the controversy has arisen.
